mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID as userId, USER_PW as userPw, USER_NAME as userName, USER_EMAIL as userEmail, USER_TYPE as userType FROM MEMBERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USER_PW = #{userPw}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBERS SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, USER_EMAIL = #{userEmail}, USER_TYPE = 'FULL' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
